question: Which deities must be invoked at the beginning for ritual success?
premises: The invocation occurs at the beginning of the rite.
The purpose is the success of the rite.
inference: Durgā and Bhadrakālī must be invoked at the beginning of the rite for its success.
plain_english: Durgā and indeed Bhadrakālī are to be invoked at the beginning of the rite for the success of the rite.
